remaining: The actual role of password, IV, rights and file-app is unestablished beyond encoding/length. A field name is not an algorithm or usable credential.

Payload lengths are not multiples of 16 and literal PDF/ZIP tokens are absent; these facts do not identify a cipher or exclude additional framing/compression.
Certificate signature, trust, validity, ownership and authorization are not evaluated.
